title: Matterbridge HomeWizard Energy plugin
description: Expose HomeWizard Energy devices (P1, kWh Meter, Watermeter, Plug/Socket) to Matter via the local API. Enable 'Local API' in the HomeWizard Energy app: Settings -> Meters -> [device] -> Local API.

devices.description: List of HomeWizard devices to expose

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the device

type.description: Optional product type hint (auto-detected if omitted), e.g. HWE-P1, HWE-KWH1, HWE-KWH3, HWE-SKT, HWE-WTR

whiteList.description: Only expose devices in this list (by name or serial)

blackList.description: Never expose devices in this list (by name or serial)
